assimilation_semantics.source_success: Broadcast only prior-layer workers with all Core tests passed and no infrastructure failure.
assimilation_semantics.no_success_behavior: Broadcast no experience; never fall back to partial or failed trajectories.

replication_policy.existing_pilot: Reuse the completed official pilot as replicate 1.
replication_policy.additional_runs: Run replicates 2 and 3 without changing the task, agent, layer count, worker count, step budget, verification rule, or experience limit.
replication_policy.order_control: Alternate mode order across replicates; an odd number of replicates cannot be perfectly balanced.
replication_policy.primary_performance_outcome: Replicate-level source_success minus no_transfer layer-2 mean Core score.
replication_policy.activation_rule: Analyze performance effects only for source_success replicates whose layer 1 creates at least one full-Core source and whose layer 2 receives it.
replication_policy.interpretation_rule: Three engineering replicates can establish trend stability but are not sufficient for a manuscript-level causal claim.

interpretation: Three-replicate strict verified-success MoA contrast reusing the completed two-layer pilot as replicate 1.
